2607.24126.title: EEGForceFusion: Joint Tokenised-Continuous Representation Learning for Subject-Independent Grasp Force Decoding
2607.24126.paper_summary: Brain-machine interfaces provide a link between neural activity and external devices, enabling restoration of motor function and advancing human-machine interaction using non-invasive electroencephalography (EEG). However, continuous grasp force decoding remains challenging due to complex temporal dynamics, high inter-subject variability, and limited generalisation of existing approaches. To address this, we propose a hybrid EEG decoding framework that jointly models continuous and tokenised representations, enabling capture of both fine-grained neural structure and long-range temporal dependencies. The proposed approach integrates convolutional-recurrent representation learning, quantisation-based tokenisation, and transformer-based temporal modelling within a unified fusion-based regression architecture. Experimental evaluation on the WAY-EEG-GAL dataset under strict leave-one-subject-out conditions achieves $R^2$ = 0.817 in offline settings and $R^2$ = 0.793 in simulated real-time evaluation, with latency suitable for real-time deployment. These results demonstrate strong cross-subject generalisation and highlight the practicality of hybrid continuous-tokenised representations for real-time EEG-based force decoding in assistive robotics, neuro-rehabilitation, and human-machine interaction.
2607.24126.paper_summary_zh: 腦機接口提供了神經活動與外部設備之間的連結，使得運動功能的恢復成為可能，並利用非侵入性的腦電圖（EEG）促進人機互動。<lb/>然而，由於複雜的時間動態、高度的個體差異以及現有方法的有限泛化，持續的握力解碼仍然具有挑戰性。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了一個混合EEG解碼框架，該框架共同建模持續與標記化的表示，能夠捕捉到細緻的神經結構和長距離的時間依賴性。<lb/>所提出的方法在統一的基於融合的回歸架構中整合了卷積-遞歸表示學習、基於量化的標記化和基於Transformer的時間建模。<lb/>在嚴格的留一個受試者的條件下，對WAY-EEG-GAL數據集的實驗評估在離線設置中達到了$R^2$ = 0.817，在模擬實時評估中達到了$R^2$ = 0.793，延遲適合實時部署。<lb/>這些結果展示了強大的跨受試者泛化能力，並突顯了混合持續-標記化表示在助理機器人、神經康復和人機互動中進行基於EEG的實時力解碼的實用性。
